item.title: Cuento ~Wasureenu Hibi ni~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: M'
  • 発売日: 1997-05-09
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: クエント ～忘れ得ぬ日々に～
  • 英語名: Cuento Wasureenu Hibi ni

别名

  • Quento

あらすじ

A collection of three short stories.

  1. Rainy Blue: A sad story about a Japanese expatriate with terminal illness, his adopted western daughter, and his original families in Japan, told from each other’s perspective.

2: Secret School Diary: A guy lays down a bet against his female teacher to pick up 4 girls in one day, for the reward of a date with her.
